controls.mechanism: native account and group controls
controls.desiredState: individual standard accounts, dedicated automation identity, protected homes, and no shared login
controls.positiveProbe: enumerate declared identities, grants, home ownership, and denied shared-login state
controls.negativeProbe: attempt an undeclared identity and cross-account access
controls.recovery: retain an independently verified local administrator or console path

controls.mechanism: OpenSSH effective configuration plus transport policy
controls.desiredState: declared users and sources only, key authentication, no password login, and no direct human root login
controls.positiveProbe: open a fresh declared-user session from an allowed source
controls.negativeProbe: deny wrong user, source, password login, and direct root login
controls.recovery: arm local rollback and retain independent console access before change

controls.mechanism: qualified Linux firewall with explicit container-rule ownership
controls.desiredState: deny undeclared host and forwarded ingress while preserving declared management and recovery paths
controls.positiveProbe: reach every declared host and container service before and after restart
controls.negativeProbe: deny unpublished, prohibited east-west, and undeclared container-published paths
controls.recovery: restore the last validated ruleset from the armed local rollback

controls.mechanism: Fail2ban SSH jail using the observed authentication-log backend
controls.desiredState: sshd jail only; maxretry 5 within 600 seconds; 600-second ban; one protected recovery source; bounded journal and action load
controls.positiveProbe: trigger the bounded SSH failure threshold from a disposable source and observe the temporary ban
controls.negativeProbe: prove expiry or manual unban and continued independent recovery access
controls.recovery: disable the scoped jail through the local rollback and unban the disposable test source

controls.mechanism: auditd watches for account, privilege, and critical security configuration changes
controls.desiredState: bounded path/watch rules, bounded backlog and disk use, no blanket syscall or process-argument capture
controls.positiveProbe: perform a synthetic declared configuration change and find its sanitized audit event
controls.negativeProbe: prove unrelated command arguments and canary values are absent from collected evidence
controls.recovery: restore the previous validated rule set and preserve existing system logs

controls.mechanism: AIDE over an explicit stable control-host file scope
controls.desiredState: trusted immutable baseline, explicit exclusions, change alert, and reviewed baseline refresh
controls.positiveProbe: change a synthetic watched file and observe a sanitized integrity alert
controls.negativeProbe: reject a missing, stale, or silently refreshed baseline
controls.recovery: restore watched configuration from the approved recovery point before rebuilding the baseline

controls.mechanism: AppArmor service and declared workload profiles
controls.desiredState: enforcing mode for applicable declared profiles without global disablement
controls.positiveProbe: run the declared workload within its enforcing profile
controls.negativeProbe: deny a synthetic action prohibited by the profile
controls.recovery: restore the last validated profile while leaving global confinement enabled

controls.mechanism: native signed repository, security-data, malware-data, and revocation update mechanisms
controls.desiredState: security-data health is evaluated independently from the seven-day OS and package soak policy
controls.positiveProbe: observe current signed security-data metadata and separately report pending OS packages
controls.negativeProbe: reject disabled, unsigned, failed, or stale security-data state
controls.recovery: retain the last verified platform state and block new admission until update health returns

controls.mechanism: qualified OS-native volume encryption and recovery custody
controls.desiredState: declared volumes encrypted with independently recoverable keys and no plaintext recovery material
controls.positiveProbe: verify effective encryption state and an independently held recovery reference
controls.negativeProbe: deny admission for unencrypted required volumes or missing recovery custody
controls.recovery: use the independently held recovery procedure without exposing key material

controls.mechanism: SIP, Gatekeeper, XProtect, native application firewall, sharing controls, and local consent
controls.desiredState: native protections enabled; declared Remote Login users only; Full Disk Access disabled absent separate approval
controls.positiveProbe: verify native protections, declared SSH user, application firewall, consent, and post-reboot state
controls.negativeProbe: deny disabled protection, undeclared sharing, absent consent, and reboot drift
controls.recovery: use physical local-console recovery and supported recoveryOS procedures

controls.mechanism: role-specific service identity, filesystem, network, and resource boundaries
controls.desiredState: one role receives only its declared workload and credential capabilities
controls.positiveProbe: run an admitted synthetic workload within its declared role limits
controls.negativeProbe: deny cross-role data, credential, control-plane, and host namespace access
controls.recovery: stop new workload admission while preserving safe existing workloads and recovery

expected.reason: every supported profile and role has a complete control-to-test mapping

controls.mechanism: no universal fallback

controls.negativeProbe: reject use of a nearby supported profile
